statements.t: During the year ended December 31, 2023, the Company made the strategic decision to exit its Marketing Services business by the end of 2028 as part of its plan to fully transition into a SaaS-driven business model.
Subsequent to us issuing SaaS Adjusted EBITDA guidance for third quarter of 2026 on August 4, 2026, we entered into the Purchase Agreement for the sale of the Print Business.

At the time we issued the Q3 2026 SaaS Adjusted EBITDA guidance, we prepared the guidance using the historical cost allocation approach, which allocates shared costs of the SaaS segment and the Marketing Services segment based on each segment’s percentage of revenue.
7 Reflects our originally reported third quarter 2026 forward-looking non-GAAP guidance from August 4, 2026.
We calculate forward-looking non-GAAP financial measures based on internal forecasts that omit certain amounts that would be included in GAAP financial measures.
